newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bank of Japan says regrets DKB arrests.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Japan says regrets DKB arrests.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Thursday that it regretted the arrests of four Dai-ichi Kangyo Bank (DKB) officials on suspicion of making illegal loans to corporate racketeers.
"We find the incident, which followed a raid (on DKB headquarters), extremely regrettable," the central bank said in a statement.
But it declined to comment any further, saying that the Tokyo Prosecutors Office was still in the process of investigating the details.
DKB, at a news conference, apologised for the arrests and said it hoped to improve its business practises as soon as possible.
